source_context: Selected diff removes duplicated initializer helpers and uses matched media_kit Initializer for WebP conversion. MpvHandleReleaser marks released once, detaches events, optionally quits, then schedules destroy after five seconds; creation continuation releases a handle returned after cancellation. Shutdown callback completes once and uses same release owner. Tests inspect scheduling order/idempotence only and were not executed. A five-second timer is a scoped source workaround, not proof all native event-loop users drained. Later app lock moves media_kit to a handle-destruction-fix fork, whose internals were not fetched/audited; do not claim crash fixed or all forks safe. PiliNara copied this exact patch (stable patch IDs equal), not independent corroboration. Consumer recommends explicit event-loop quiescence where available and labels a fixed delay as heuristic.
